en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5) 11.15.
Vitakkattikādi, Kusalattika (The Wholesome Triplet, beginning with the Triplet of Applied Thought)

Dependent on a non-virtuous state that is with applied thought and sustained thought … dependent on a non-virtuous state that is without applied thought and with sustained thought only … dependent on a non-virtuous state that is without applied thought and without sustained thought … (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are forty-eight; under object-condition, forty-seven … under prenascence and repetition conditions, forty-six … under non-disappearance condition, forty-eight.

Dependent on a non-virtuous state not accompanied by joy … pe … dependent on a non-virtuous state not accompanied by pleasure … pe … dependent on a non-virtuous state not accompanied by equanimity … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are forty-nine … pe … under the prenascence and repetition conditions there are forty-eight … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are forty-nine.
Dependent on a non-virtuous state not to be abandoned by seeing … pe … dependent on a non-virtuous state not to be abandoned by cultivation … pe … [the same as above].
Dependent on a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, which is unwholesome … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is unwholesome, whose root is not to be abandoned by vision … pe … whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation … pe …
Dependent on an unwholesome state … [and so on] … dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation … (Abbreviated.

Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … [and so on] … under the ripening condition, nine … [and so on] … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither leading to accumulation nor wholesome... dependent on a state that is neither leading to dispersal nor wholesome... dependent on a state that is neither leading to accumulation nor dispersal nor wholesome...
(Abbreviated. Under root: twenty-one; under object: seventeen... under result: nine... under non-disappearance: twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is neither of the higher training nor wholesome... dependent on a state that is neither of the higher training nor wholesome... dependent on a state that is neither of the higher training nor of the higher training nor wholesome... (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition, there are twenty-nine; with respect to the object condition, twenty-four … pe … with respect to the repetition condition, nine … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither limited nor unwholesome … pe … dependent on a state that is neither exalted nor unwholesome … pe … dependent on a state that is neither immeasurable nor unwholesome … (Abbreviated.

With respect to the root condition, there are thirty-two; with respect to the object condition, twenty-seven … pe … with respect to the mutuality condition, thirty … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, thirty-two.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state with limited object … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state with exalted object … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state with immeasurable object … pe … Dependent on a non-inferior non-wholesome state … pe … dependent on a non-middling non-wholesome state … pe … dependent on a non-superior non-wholesome state … (Abbreviated.

Under root-condition there are twenty-nine; under object-condition, twenty-four … pe … under repetition-condition, seventeen; under result-condition, twenty-one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, twenty-nine.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not fixed in wrongness (*micchatta-niyata*), ... [and so on] ... dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not fixed in rightness (*sammatta-niyata*), ... [and so on] ... dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not indeterminate (*aniyata*). (Abbreviated. Under root-condition (*hetu*) there are twenty-one; under object-condition (*ārammaṇa*) there are seventeen, ...
[and so on] ... under result-condition (*vipāka*) there are nine, ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*) there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state that does not have the Path as its object (*na-maggārammaṇa*), ... [and so on] ... dependent on a non-wholesome state that does not have the Path as its root (*na-maggahetuka*), ... [and so on] ... dependent on a non-wholesome state that does not have the Path as its dominating factor (*na-maggādhipati*).

Not dependent on a non-arisen unwholesome state … pe … not dependent on a non-arisen unwholesome state that has arisen … Not dependent on a past unwholesome state … pe … not dependent on a future unwholesome state … Not dependent on a past-object unwholesome state … pe … not dependent on a future-object unwholesome state … pe … not dependent on a present-object unwholesome state … pe … [the same applies to] wholesome states.]
Dependent on an internal non-virtuous state …pe… dependent on an external non-virtuous state …pe….
Dependent on an internally objectified non-virtuous state …pe… dependent on an externally objectified non-virtuous state …pe….
